intent: Review a direct debit order and its line details.
actions: Sign in as an administrator with direct debit and bank transfer enabled. Use numeric order and line IDs that do not exist for the following direct links.
Navigate through Banks and direct debit payments to the direct debit order list, and wait for it to load.
Open /compta/prelevement/card.php?id=<order-id> directly, replacing <order-id> with the missing order ID, and wait for the page to load.
Open /compta/prelevement/fiche-rejet.php?id=<order-id> directly for that same missing order in the same browser and wait for the page to load.
Open /compta/prelevement/fiche-stat.php?id=<order-id> directly for that same missing order in the same browser and wait for the page to load.
Open /compta/prelevement/line.php?id=<line-id> directly, replacing <line-id> with the missing line ID, and wait for the page to load.
